method: 20 alternating hot samples each scene/profile/version; gl.finish/readPixels plus measured signs and conservative per-frame context CPU (native context is throttled to 0.3 s), 480×320 DPR1 SwiftShader. Frozen identical camera/date/climate time/cover, native geometry/materials; signs update included. No concurrent graphic workload. Logical GL bytes, not physical VRAM. Separate active effects costs in native traces.
